overview_description.description: Ash Games Studio is an independent game development studio that creates action-adventure games inspired by Arabic culture, history, and mythology. It develops original titles for PC and consoles, including Nomad, an action-adventure roguelite, and Azooma Escape, a stealth-comedy game. The studio also provides game development services and works on publishing, partnerships, and interactive entertainment projects.
